off_machine_backup.acl_limitation: FAT32 cannot store Windows ACLs, so no per-user permission is enforced on the device. Physical custody of the pendrive is the control; the Owner is responsible for storing it safely.
off_machine_backup.contents_policy: the device holds ONLY the key backup and its manifest - no position ledger, no protected outcome, no snapshot, no repository file, no target data

policy: the off-machine backup must live in a SEPARATE failure domain from the live key
losing the only key makes every protected record permanently unrecoverable
the key is never committed, never logged, never printed, never emailed
restoration must verify THIS fingerprint; restoring a different key is forbidden
no cloud-sync destination may be used without a separate Owner decision
key_backup.restore_test: PASS from the USB backup: copied to an isolated temporary recovery directory, fingerprint verified against the authoritative value, a synthetic AES-GCM envelope decrypted to its exact plaintext, temporary artifacts destroyed. The live production key was never replaced and no real prospective position or protected outcome was decrypted.

same_machine_backup.limitation: same machine and same physical disk as the live key; protects against accidental deletion or corruption of the store, NOT against disk or machine loss

owner_authorization.scope: C_A_GO_LIVE ONLY - not a run, not a reveal, not C-D, not Phase C

post_seal_unscored_state_input_only.window: observations after the C-A seal and strictly before PROSPECTIVE_START
